confine.name: mantine-ui-adapters
confine.message: Only web/src/common/ui/<component> adapters may import Mantine; consume readonly props/slots contracts instead.

confine.name: no-reatom-jsx
confine.message: Runlark uses React + Mantine adapters with Reatom v1001, never @reatom/jsx.

confine.name: no-reatom-in-presentational-ui
confine.message: Presentational common/ui adapters and common helpers must remain pure props/slots-only without Reatom hooks or state.
